HOW ARE YOU PLAYING?

WASD move · Shift sprint · hold left click to shoot, right click for a finesse shot (E while charging: curve, A / D to bend) · mouse look (click to capture) · wheel zoom · V slow walk · Z spin · X side boost · C flick · F go limp / get up · E pass (hold E to call for a through ball) · R lofted pass · 1 (or T) reset the scene · P pause (scenarios in the pause menu)
